seedPlan.guide: Hiragana/katakana recognition for absolute beginners. Mix: look-alike katakana pairs (シ/ツ, ソ/ン), voiced/semi-voiced marks (か/が, は/ぱ), small kana (きょ vs きよ), sokuon (っ) and long-vowel reading (おばさん/おばあさん). Question forms: 'which reading is correct for this word written in kana', or 'which word matches this reading'. Answerable without audio. Stems may add a short Korean gloss.
Basic grammar for beginners: particles (は/が/を/に/で/へ/と), verb and adjective conjugation (て-form, ない-form, past), basic sentence patterns. Full sentences with clear context.
Basic vocabulary in context: choose the word that fits the blank (verbs, adjectives, adverbs, everyday nouns), transitive vs intransitive pairs, counters.
Grammar at the target level in real sentence context: pick the form or pattern that fits. Include look-alike patterns Korean speakers confuse.
Vocabulary at the target level in context: choose the word that fits the blank; include a Sino-Japanese false friend for Korean speakers.

domainGuides.READING_KANJI: Kanji reading questions: a word written in kanji (sentence context) and 4 candidate readings; include on/kun traps, long vowels, voiced/unvoiced differences, small tsu. The stem shows the word in a short sentence.
domainGuides.ORTHOGRAPHY: Orthography questions: a word written in kana inside a sentence and 4 candidate kanji spellings, including look-alike kanji and Sino-Japanese words that differ from Korean hanja usage.
domainGuides.CONTEXT: Vocabulary-in-context questions: choose the word that fits the blank (verbs, adjectives, adverbs, nouns), including transitive/intransitive pairs and false friends for Korean speakers.
